# Cache ownership and completion

Import the owning module directly. The package-level `../mod.ts` remains the intentional broad
entry point; this folder has no local barrel.

| Capability             | Owner and dataflow                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Latest values          | [LatestValue](LatestValue.ts) owns synchronous writes, expiry and validation. [LatestRepository](LatestRepository.ts) owns keyed entries, capacity and eviction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Refreshed values       | [LoanedValue](LoanedValue.ts) owns refresh coalescing and expiry. [LoanedRepository](LoanedRepository.ts) supplies keyed refreshers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Observable caches      | [ObservableLatestValue](observable/observable-latest-value.ts) and [ObservableLoanedValue](observable/observable-loaned-value.ts) classify changes from their underlying values. [ObservableLatestRepository](observable/observable-latest-repository.ts) and [ObservableLoanedRepository](observable/observable-loaned-repository.ts) publish keyed changes and own entry lifetime.                                                                                        |
| Awaited delivery       | [QueuedNotifications](observable/queued-notifications.ts) captures typed/all-change subscribers, delivers one event at a time, and awaits all observers and error reporting for that event. Cache owners combine its completion with their own refresh and entry work.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Same-turn delivery     | [SynchronousNotifications](synchronous-notifications.ts) delivers captured committed batches or supersedable latest state synchronously. It isolates asynchronous rejections but does not await observers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Persistence            | [WriteThroughObservableLatestRepository](store-backed/write-through-observable-latest-repository.ts) commits storage before updating memory. [WriteBehindObservableLatestRepository](store-backed/write-behind-observable-latest-repository.ts) mirrors memory events to storage. Their `flush()`/`whenIdle()` include their write chains. [VersionProbedReadThroughCache](store-backed/version-probed-read-through-cache.ts) checks version before loading a cached value. |
| Newest-N retention     | [retainNewest](retain-newest.ts) keeps the newest `limit` of an oldest-first list and returns what fell off. It is a pure list primitive; keyed capacity stays with `LatestRepository`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| History                | [MementoValue](MementoValue.ts), [LatestMementoValue](LatestMementoValue.ts) and [LoanedMementoValue](LoanedMementoValue.ts) own value history. [LatestMementoRepository](LatestMementoRepository.ts) and [LoanedMementoRepository](LoanedMementoRepository.ts) own keyed history; [MementoLoanedValue](MementoLoanedValues.ts) supplies loaned history composition.                                                                                                        |
| Registration           | [RepositoryManager](RepositoryManager.ts), [RepositoryToken](RepositoryToken.ts), [RepositoryTokens](RepositoryTokens.ts) and [defaultRepositoryManager](defaultRepositoryManager.ts) own repository identity, defaults and disposal. [configureLatestRepository](configure-latest-repository.ts) owns replacement configuration and its default-manager boundary.                                                                                                          |
| Commands               | [Command](Command.ts), [AsyncCommand](AsyncCommand.ts) and [PullPushCommand](PullPushCommand.ts) own command execution. [CommandsOrchestrator](CommandsOrchestrator.ts) composes execution policies.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Contracts and eviction | [ReadableValue](ReadableValue.ts) and [RepositoryInterfaces](RepositoryInterfaces.ts) define cache reads/events. [startExpiredEntryEviction](ExpiredEntryEviction.ts) owns the timed eviction resource.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

Queued cache writes change their value immediately. Publication captures the audience at that
point; removing a subscription affects subsequent publications, not events already captured.
Listeners in the same event run concurrently. A listener registered for both the event type and all
changes receives both deliveries; registering twice within one group is deduplicated. An old
unsubscribe handle cannot remove a later registration.

`whenIdle()` includes events enqueued by observers. Loaned values also wait for owned refreshes;
repositories wait for entry work started by their observers. Removed latest entries remain tracked
until their committed notifications finish; removed loaned entries cannot publish a late refresh into
a replacement entry. A callback may enqueue more work, but must not await
its own cache's `whenIdle()` or `acceptAndNotify()`: that would wait on the callback itself.
Observer errors are normalized and reported; error handlers are awaited and their own failures
are isolated. Failed delivery never rolls back the already accepted cache value.

Tests mirror these owners under `packages/tests/shared/cache/observable/`. Store durability and browser-local
storage are covered by the store-backed repository tests and the browser Rallar Data tests.
